records.highlight: British doctor, Nobel laureate, writer, and artist
records.text: Ronald Ross, British doctor, Nobel laureate, writer, and artist, was born on May 13, 1857 (died 1932).
records.textJa: Ronald Ross（British doctor, Nobel laureate, writer, and artist）は1857年5月13日に生まれた（1932年死去）。

records.highlight: British doctor, Nobel laureate, writer, and artist
records.text: Ronald Ross, British doctor, Nobel laureate, writer, and artist, died on September 16, 1932, aged 75.
records.textJa: Ronald Ross（British doctor, Nobel laureate, writer, and artist）が1932年9月16日に75歳で死去した。
